Hello! My name is Eli and I'm a recent 2026 Environmental Studies graduate at the University of California Santa Barbara and a Lab Assistant for the UCSB Cheadle Center for Biodiversity and Ecological Restoration. I enjoy doing restoration work, working with plants, and learning more about the field of restoration and how to share my interest in it. Outside of work, I love surfing, hiking, cooking, socializing, and again, plants. Check out the rest of my website to learn more about me!
